desc: A third long walk northeast. The rounded mountain to the northwest (middle). "A light lies on the ash tree that nothing casts." Bare earth here and there.

features.name: ash tree
features.note: "A light lies on the ash tree that nothing casts." Examine: "Something about it is wrong, and you can't say what."

name: The lit ash tree
notes: Touch: "feels ordinary, and still something is off." Listen: "Faintly, a whistle from the north. Faintly, a whistle from the northeast." Smell: flowers. Dig: nothing. "light torch": no flame.
statusNote: Looked, examined, touched, listened, smelled, dug. The light can't light a torch.
